items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I played some jobs with him, but he's a comical man.

ctx.x: Joe Phillips or whatever. Yeah, Babe Phillips.
I played some jobs with him, but he's a comical man. Yeah, he couldn't speak English out of him. No, you couldn't understand him. That's right.
Where did you get that vega banjo?
